mapper.select: SELECT id FROM loyalty.auth_principal WHERE principal_type = #{principalType} AND subject = #{subject} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT DISTINCT p.code AS permission_code, pr.scope_type, pr.tenant_id, pr.program_id FROM loyalty.auth_principal_role pr JOIN loyalty.auth_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = pr.role_id JOIN loyalty.auth_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE pr.principal_id = #{principalId} AND pr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (pr.effective_to IS NULL OR pr.effective_to > now())

SELECT pr.id AS binding_id, pr.principal_id, pr.role_id, r.code AS role_code, pr.scope_type, pr.tenant_id, pr.program_id FROM loyalty.auth_principal_role pr JOIN loyalty.auth_role r ON r.id = pr.role_id WHERE pr.principal_id = #{principalId} AND pr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (pr.effective_to IS NULL OR pr.effective_to > now())
